BCEAO/UEMOA - gain of about 25 points since 2016, driven by 196.4 million accounts opened
Target set by the Regional Financial Inclusion Strategy 2025-2030, adopted in Dakar on 3 April 2025
GSMA State of the Industry Report on Mobile Money 2026, via Ecofin Agency - second-largest region after East Africa (806 Bn USD), 517 million accounts
